strategy_roster.name: Double Up
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is unavailable, so the documented CciPeriod 8 oscillator returning from its extreme is approximated by RSI(8) crossing back above a low level, with the documented MACD 13/33 main line still negative; the Threshold 230 is rescaled to the RSI scale. Exponential martingale sizing is not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Arttrader
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(ema(open, 20), 3) > 0 and close > ema(open, 20) and open - close < 0.005 * close
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA of the open with a rising slope and the price-position filter is kept, and the big-gap volatility guard becomes a limit on the bar's own open-to-close loss. The EMA period is an explicit default, and the pip-based emergency stop, take-profit, timed stop and slope bounds are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Rampok Scalp
strategy_roster.notes: The moving average envelope is approximated by Bollinger bands, and the documented buy on a cross back above the lower band is expressed as a cross of the current close over that band. No envelope periods or stop/target values are documented, so 20 and null are used.

strategy_roster.name: Simple Trading System
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(ema(close, 2), 4) <= 0 and roc(close, 4) >= 0 and roc(close, 6) <= 0 and close < open
strategy_roster.exit_long: roc(ema(close, 2), 4) >= 0 and roc(close, 4) <= 0 and roc(close, 6) >= 0 and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: The documented rules map one-to-one using the default MaType EMA, MaPeriod 2 and MaShift 4: ROC over 4 and 6 bars stands in for the shifted close comparisons, and the bearish candle test closes the long entry. The 1000/2000 stop and target are absolute price units, not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Colibri Grid Manager
strategy_roster.notes: This is a discretionary grid manager that stages layered pending orders around anchor prices with risk sizing, a daily loss limit and manual maintenance commands, so it has no single-symbol market signal. A never-true guard is used.

strategy_roster.name: Rollback System
strategy_roster.entry_long: (roc(open, 24) < -1 and close - donchian_low_prev(low, 24) < 0.01 * close) or (roc(open, 24) > 1 and donchian_high_prev(high, 24) - close > 0.02 * close)
strategy_roster.notes: Both documented long rules are kept: an extended 24-bar down day closing near its low, and an extended up day closing far below its high, with the pip thresholds normalised to 1% and 2%. Signals are only taken once per day at 00:00 in the original and pip-based stops, so the time gate is dropped.

strategy_roster.name: WPR Histogram
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is unavailable, so its overbought/oversold zones are mapped to RSI(14) with 80/20 equivalents; the long is the documented fall back from the high level while still above the midpoint. The WPR period and both level values are undocumented (14/80/20 used), and docs state no stops are set.

strategy_roster.name: Aroon Oscillator Sign Alert
strategy_roster.notes: Aroon is not in the DSL, so the oscillator is approximated by price position within the 10-bar range scaled to +/-100; crossing above the documented DownLevel -50 opens long and crossing below the UpLevel +50 reverses. Multiplying through by the range avoids a division by zero in flat series. Docs state no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Pairs
strategy_roster.notes: The documented entry requires a separate reference asset's candle direction, so the condition is not computable from a single symbol. A never-true guard is used; the close above the previous high exit is not translated without a valid entry.

strategy_roster.name: Stop Loss to Break-Even
strategy_roster.notes: Docs state the strategy generates no entry signals and only moves an existing position's stop to break-even after BreakEvenPips. A never-true guard is used, and the pip trigger is order management rather than a DSL condition.
